experiments.paper_location: Section 4.3 angular LSH; Section 5.1 implementation choice omitting Equation 8 augmented MIPS
experiments.mechanism: Fixed projection SimHash, little-endian bit packing and empirical offloaded-mean key centering from actual pinned Python statement blocks.

conditions.execution: AST-selected archived packing/fill/decode assignments execute on explicit restricted CPU list-tensor adapter
conditions.seed: fixed literal projections and synthetic keys, no RNG
conditions.oracle: Independent literal dot/sign/code tables; dense FP64 attention before and after common translation; integer bit-code enumeration
conditions.ordering: K/L=(3,2),(2,3), two KV heads and two query batches, strict-positive zero ties, repeated runs and partial chunk
conditions.centering: offloaded-key mean also subtracted from retained sink/local and newly appended keys; two heads and two append batches
conditions.packing: 4094 exact bit codes across K=1..11; all-one K12..15 examples lose exactness in binary16; K15 rounded 32768 exceeds positive int16
conditions.adapter_arithmetic: FP64 projection/mean/norm; struct binary16 sum rounding; only nonnegative in-range int16 casts

experiments.note: Support characterization of actual pinned assignment blocks, not the full attention server or GPU/PyTorch BF16 rounding. Empirical mean-centering is not Equation 8 augmented MIPS. Packing loss is documented without repairing immutable historical behavior; zero-norm queries and empty offload ranges are outside this fixture.
